brief:
In Gaza, access to lighters has become critical to survival as fuel shortages prevent residents from cooking meals, Al Jazeera English reported. The scarcity of this simple tool now determines whether families can prepare food or go hungry. Residents lacking lighters cannot ignite alternative cooking methods when traditional fuel supplies run dry.

The shortage reflects broader supply constraints affecting Gaza's ability to meet basic needs. With limited fuel and cooking gas unavailable, lighters have emerged as an essential commodity for those attempting to maintain minimum standards of living. The tool's newfound importance illustrates how the humanitarian crisis has stripped away conventional resources, forcing Palestinians to improvise with whatever materials remain accessible.
dek: In Gaza the struggle to find lighters can mean the difference between cooking a meal or going to bed hungry.
title: Lighters become lifeline as Gaza faces fuel shortage
